summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package is published as an ESLint formatjs config but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with string-array indirection, rotated identifiers, and non-readable variable names, so its behavior is not inspectable from source. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated (`_0x...` identifier scheme, aliased dispatch objects) and fingerprints the host libc via `ldd --version` and `/etc/os-release` to select an Alpine/musl Bun variant. An ESLint config has no need for a second language runtime or a large opaque payload; the effect on `npm install` is execution of attacker-chosen bytes under a runtime that the installer's Node-based tooling does not evaluate.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
